import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Transaction Amount by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['transaction_type'].unique()))
bars = ax1.bar(df['transaction_type'], df['amount'], color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, amount in zip(bars, df['amount']):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 10, 
             f'${amount:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Transaction Count by Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, 
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(type_counts))
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Amount Distribution by Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['hour_of_day'], df['amount'], 
                       c=[colors[list(df['transaction_type'].unique()).index(t)] 
                          for t in df['transaction_type']], 
                       s=150, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 4))

# Add legend for transaction types
for i, t_type in enumerate(df['transaction_type'].unique()):
    ax3.scatter([], [], c=[colors[i]], s=100, label=t_type, edgecolors='black')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type', loc='upper left')

# Plot 4: Summary Statistics Table
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
ax4.axis('off')

# Create summary statistics
summary_data = [
    ['Metric', 'Value'],
    ['Total Transactions', len(df)],
    ['Total Amount', f'${df["amount"].sum():.2f}'],
    ['Average Amount', f'${df["amount"].mean():.2f}'],
    ['Max Amount', f'${df["amount"].max():.2f}'],
    ['Min Amount', f'${df["amount"].min():.2f}'],
    ['Fraud Cases', df['is_fraud'].sum()],
    ['Most Common Type', df['transaction_type'].mode()[0]]
]

table = ax4.table(cellText=summary_data[1:], colLabels=summary_data[0],
                   cellLoc='center', loc='center',
                   colColours=['#4a90d9', '#4a90d9'],
                   colWidths=[0.4, 0.4])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(11)
table.scale(1.2, 1.8)
ax4.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
